description: Morpho-sédimentologie et courants de marée 3D de la zone éolien posé de Saint-Nazaire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Shom. SHOM, a public institution of reference in terms of hydrography and marine sediments, has been subsidized by Europe, the representation of the State in the Pays de la Loire region (SGAR) and the Pays de la Loire region to acquire initial knowledge of the physical marine environment on the Saint-Nazaire wind zone. Coverage: Shom. The portal shows the English title as "Morpho-sedimentology and 3D tidal currents of the Saint-Nazaire laid wind zone" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Shom. Its keywords include courants, maree, emr, bathymetrie, sediments. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, ASC. The listing shows 2026-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
